project_info.name: RPS Grade 4 Programming Homework Portal (2026/2027)
project_info.description: Grade 4 Programming Homework Portal with student packages, daily tasks, exam monitoring, anti-cheat security, and PostgreSQL/Supabase backend.

environment_variables.description: Secret key used for signing JWT tokens

ai_activity_logs.author: Antigravity AI
ai_activity_logs.action: Created vibecode-log.json and updated backend auto-migration for Supabase deployment.
ai_activity_logs.issue_diagnosed: Render backend failed on launch with error: 'relation "users" does not exist' because Supabase DB was empty and init.sql was not automatically executed on startup.
changes_made: Created vibecode-log.json in project root directory for context sharing across devices.
Updated backend/index.js initDB() to execute backend/init.sql automatically on startup if tables are missing.
Added auto-seeding in initDB() for admin account (admin/admin123), student accounts, and curriculum topics/questions from CSV.
ai_activity_logs.instructions_for_next_ai: When starting on a new device, check DATABASE_URL environment variable in Render. On deployment, node index.js will execute init.sql to build tables automatically and seed default data. Default admin login is admin/admin123.

ai_activity_logs.author: Antigravity AI
ai_activity_logs.action: Fixed homework exit navigation & enforced student package access security.
ai_activity_logs.issue_diagnosed: Exiting a homework assignment directed students to homework/homework-X/index.html (Homework Package Grid) instead of Student Dashboard (../../index.html), allowing students to view and access other students' homework packages.
changes_made: Updated all exit/back links across all homework HTML files and scripts (generate-homeworks.js, setup-homework-2.js) to point directly to '../../index.html' (Student Dashboard).
Enhanced js/security.js to block students from viewing package files that do not belong to them, automatically redirecting non-owners to '../../index.html'.
Updated js/homework-loader.js to filter package cards on homework/homework-X/index.html so student accounts only see their own assigned package card, while admin accounts can view all cards.
ai_activity_logs.instructions_for_next_ai: Students exiting homework will now return directly to the Student Dashboard (../../index.html). If a student attempts to open another student's homework URL, security.js will block access and redirect to the Student Dashboard.

ai_activity_logs.author: Antigravity AI
ai_activity_logs.action: Activated full anti-inspect, anti-right-click, anti-copy, and shortcut protection system.
ai_activity_logs.issue_diagnosed: Students could potentially use right-click (context menu), inspect element (F12 / Ctrl+Shift+I / Ctrl+Shift+J / Ctrl+U), text selection, copy-paste shortcuts, or devtools to copy questions or cheat.
changes_made: Activated right-click (contextmenu) blocking with security toast alerts in js/security.js.
Blocked F12, Ctrl+Shift+I, Ctrl+Shift+J, Ctrl+Shift+C, Ctrl+U, Ctrl+S, Ctrl+P, Ctrl+C, Ctrl+A shortcuts with custom warning modal and toasts.
Blocked text selection, drag-and-drop, copy, cut, and paste events on question pages.
Added dynamic DevTools window dimension detector to detect open inspect windows.
Exempted Admin accounts (role === 'admin') so teachers can inspect and grade without restrictions.
ai_activity_logs.instructions_for_next_ai: Anti-cheat protection is active for student accounts across all homework pages. Admins remain unrestricted.

ai_activity_logs.author: Antigravity AI
ai_activity_logs.action: Added Daily Tasks Edit Dashboard & support for multiple correct answers.
ai_activity_logs.issue_diagnosed: Teachers could not easily edit daily tasks (questions and answers) directly from the dashboard, and the system needed to accept multiple correct answers for a single task.
changes_made: Enabled the Edit Daily Tasks UI section in admin.html.
Added loadEditTasks, openEditTaskModal, saveTaskEdit, and deleteTask functions in js/admin.js.
Updated switchTab and loadTopics in js/admin.js to render and hook up the edit tasks interface.
Confirmed backend support for multiple correct answers using pipe (|) delimiter in expected answers.
ai_activity_logs.instructions_for_next_ai: To specify multiple correct answers, separate them using a pipe character (|) in the expected answer field (e.g., HTML|html|Hyper Text). The backend automatically splits these and compares against user input.

ai_activity_logs.author: Antigravity AI
ai_activity_logs.action: Updated JSON templates and added full system support for MCQ and True/False questions.
ai_activity_logs.issue_diagnosed: The teacher required more diverse question types like MCQ and True/False in the downloadable JSON templates, but the system (DB, backend, frontend) only fully supported short_answer and code.
changes_made: Updated template_soal.json and template_ujian.json to include 'mcq' and 'true_false' examples with an 'options' array.
Altered PostgreSQL database schema (question_bank and exam_questions) to add an 'options' JSON column.
Updated backend/index.js bulk upload and single create/update endpoints to accept, store, and return the options array.
Modified js/main.js to dynamically render radio buttons for 'mcq' and 'true_false' types in Daily Tasks and adapted submitAnswer to read from radio inputs.
ai_activity_logs.instructions_for_next_ai: When adding or editing 'mcq' or 'true_false' questions, provide an 'options' JSON array. The frontend will automatically render these as radio buttons. The correct answer in 'expected_answer' must exactly match one of the options.
